description: This file contains utility classes and functions for tracing and recording execution order and parameter usage in PyTorch's symbolic tracing framework, specifically related to torch.fx and distributed training.

classes.name: TracingConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for symbolic tracing, including tracer instance and concrete arguments.

classes.name: _ParamUsageInfo
classes.description: NamedTuple recording parameter usage information for modules during tracing.

classes.name: _ExecutionInfo
classes.description: Class storing execution order and parameter usage data during a forward pass.

classes.name: _ExecOrderTracer
classes.description: Utility class providing context management to patch torch.fx.Tracer for recording execution order and parameter usage.

methods.name: _patched_call_module
methods.description: Overrides call_module to record module execution and parameter usage during symbolic tracing.

methods.name: _patched_create_proxy
methods.description: Overrides create_proxy to record parameter usage during symbolic tracing.

methods.name: patch_tracer
methods.description: Context manager to patch a torch.fx.Tracer for tracing execution order and parameter usage.
